name: Purrloin

attacks.name: Whiny Voice
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, look at a random card from your opponent’s hand and shuffle it into their deck.

flavor:
Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable
behavior come away with stinging scratches from
its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

pokedex.text: NO. 0509 Devious Pokémon HT: 1'4" WT: 22.3 lbs.
